summary.text: Tory Marie Blew is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 33 (Barton County), serving in the Senate since 2025 after House service from 2017 to 2024. The legislature lists Blew as vice chair of the Federal and State Affairs Committee and a member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Commerce, and Local Government, Transparency and Ethics committees; the listed occupation is human resources director.
